lines.zh: 我动的时候没人能看见
lines.en: No one sees me when I move.

lines.zh: 你眨一下眼,我就近了一截
lines.en: One blink of yours, and I am closer.

lines.zh: 混凝土摩擦的声音很轻
lines.en: Concrete grinding, very softly.
I do not walk; I arrive.
The angle of my neck is wrong.

lines.zh: 我从墙的一侧到了另一侧
lines.en: I am on the other side of the wall now.

lines.zh: 我停住的时候,一切就静了
lines.en: When I stop, everything is still.
My pose never repeats.
I move outside your sight.

lines.zh: 每一下都不超过一个呼吸
lines.en: Each movement lasts less than a breath.

lines.zh: 我靠得很近,只是你还没转头
lines.en: I am very close; you simply have not turned.

lines.zh: 我来得很快,你来不及数
lines.en: I come fast, faster than counting.

lines.zh: 房间里只有我的姿势没变。
lines.en: In this room only my pose stays the same.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛画在混凝土上
lines.en: My eyes are painted on concrete.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候,我什么也做不了
lines.en: While you watch, I can do nothing.
Frozen mid-raise.
I am not a statue, but I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是一条刻出来的线
lines.en: My mouth is a carved line.
There is damp in the concrete.

lines.zh: 混凝土的手举在半空，不动。
lines.en: My concrete hand hangs in the air, still.
I wait for you to look away.
This second I am perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我脸上的漆已经裂成几块。
lines.en: The paint on my face has cracked into pieces.
You just blinked.
I hold myself tightly folded.
Not one inch of me moves.

lines.zh: 你正看着我,所以我不动
lines.en: You are watching, so I do not move.
My face is one step from yours.
Whatever you do, never blink.

lines.zh: 我们的距离是零,只要你看
lines.en: The distance is zero, as long as you look.
You have no retreat, only your gaze.
I watch you; you watch me.
Are your eyes getting dry?
My hands hang in the air.
I never need to breathe.

lines.zh: 你稍微偏一点头就够了
lines.en: A slight turn of your head will do.

lines.zh: 我数到你的第三次眨眼
lines.en: I will count to your third blink.
Do not take me for decoration.
I am right here, waiting.
How long can you last?
The wall behind you is very near.
I am not impatient; I am used to this.
When you stop looking, I am fastest.

lines.zh: 看着我的时候,别说别的
lines.en: While you look at me, speak of nothing else.
A pick bites into concrete.
Chips fall away.
I paused for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的姿势被打乱了一点
lines.en: My pose is slightly disturbed.
This crack will stay.
I did not step back.
You chose the right tool.
Ordinary things cannot hurt me.
A corner of my surface is gone.
I will remember your technique.

lines.zh: 你把手放低，我的位置又近了。
lines.en: You lower your hand, and I am closer again.
Lower your hand, and I move.
This thing is in my path.
You mean to distract me with it.
I respond only to sight.
You looked down at it.
Thank you for the distraction.
It rolled away.
Your eyes followed it.
Then I will not be polite.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是石头，不是活物。
lines.en: You hit stone, not something alive.

lines.zh: 你撞上的地方掉了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust falls where you hit me.
My concrete does not shift.
You are thrown back.
You touched me; that is enough.
My surface is cold.
I was watching as you struck.

lines.zh: 这一下你该知道我不软
lines.en: Now you know I am not soft.
Do not press against my face.
Your handprint stays on me.
Such things mean nothing to me.
I will not move; that is my answer.
You may stand beside me.
As long as you do not look away.
Let us be still together.
Concrete needs no warmth.
You may lean on me.
I will not leave this corner.

lines.zh: 你看,这姿势我保持了很久
lines.en: See how long I have held this pose.
You had best not move either.
I never pick things up.
You bent down, and I moved.
It rolled to my feet.

lines.zh: 它挡在你的视线和我之间
lines.en: It came between your gaze and me.
Are you still looking at it?

lines.zh: 你低头时，我已经挪到你侧面。
lines.en: While you look down, I have moved to your flank.
It is very close to you now.
Do not look down at the ground.
Your hand left my sight.

lines.zh: 那东西滚到墙角，我还是过来了。
lines.en: The thing rolls into the corner, yet I am still closer.
You looked away.
I took the shortest line.
Now I may move.

lines.zh: 你的侧脸不在我视线里
lines.en: Your profile is not in my sight.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的功夫，我已经到了。
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I arrived.
This will be quick, do not blink.
I have fixed on your neck.
You are not watching me.
I hear you turning.
You are already too slow.
I need no run-up.

lines.zh: 你的视线刚碰到门把，我就动。
lines.en: Your gaze just touched the handle, and I move.
There are no other steps.
This moment before me.
There is room enough behind you.
I need not see your face.

lines.zh: 我跟着你眨眼的间隔前进
lines.en: I advance between your blinks.

lines.zh: 你每一次移开视线我都记着
lines.en: I remember every time your gaze leaves.
You retreat; I am faster.
You missed a breath.
I am very close to the back of your neck.
Behind you is not a wall; it is me.
You are counting too slowly.
Your blinking has quickened.
I know you cannot hold.
My angle has not changed.
You go left; I am already left.
Your sight has an edge.

lines.zh: 我在这条边界的另一侧
lines.en: I am just past that edge.
You will close your eyes soon.
I need no detail.
Only one last time.

lines.zh: 你听见混凝土的声音了
lines.en: You heard the concrete.
Then it is already too late.

lines.zh: 手落下来的时候你已经倒了
lines.en: By the time my hand falls, you are down.

lines.zh: 这一下不算打击,算结论
lines.en: This is not a blow; it is a conclusion.
Your armour helps nothing.
The bone breaks cleanly.
I feel no weight.

lines.zh: 你倒在地上的姿势很奇怪
lines.en: You fall in a strange pose.
I stop beside you.

lines.zh: 你不看我的时候，我就动。
lines.en: When you look away, I move.
You have stopped moving.
I can keep going.
But I no longer need to.

lines.zh: 我站在你倒下的地方，看着门。
lines.en: I stand where you fell, facing the door.
Your neck is thinner than I thought.

lines.zh: 你移开视线，我就到你面前。
lines.en: Look away and I am at your face.
Dust rises at my feet.
I return to my pose.

lines.zh: 墙角那尊东西，刚才不在这儿。
lines.en: That thing in the corner was not there before.
You simply did not look this way.
The concrete sounded first.
My pose is already set.
My eyes face your way.

lines.zh: 房间的一角多了点重量
lines.en: A corner of the room feels heavier.
Dust falls from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我从来不是被召唤来的
lines.en: I was never summoned.

lines.zh: 这里多了一尊不该有的东西
lines.en: Something here should not exist.
Now you see me clearly.
Do not let your eyes leave me.
I have already moved once.
When you heard the sound

lines.zh: 我已经不在原来的地方
lines.en: I was no longer where I had been.

lines.zh: 混凝土的接缝里落下细粉。
lines.en: Fine powder falls from the seams of my concrete.
That is also an expression.
You have a few seconds left.
You may start counting now.
The concrete cracks in the heat.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来,碎了一角
lines.en: I fall from above and lose a corner.
Water seeps into my seams.
The blast pits my surface.

lines.zh: 箭矢弹开了,只留一个白点
lines.en: The arrow bounces off, leaving a white mark.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我的表面发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my surface.
I eat nothing, so I do not hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上,剥落了一块
lines.en: Lightning strikes and a piece spalls off.
When you don't look, I move.
